name: MAYA W5 — catalog sync (client sheet → Maya)

meta.why: Phase 3, plan 08: the client edits their own Google Sheet and the products update live — no CMS to build, no developer in the loop, and the sheet is a thing every shop owner already knows how to use.
meta.setup: 1) CONFIG.sheet_id = the client's sheet, CONFIG.maya_api = maya-server URL. 2) Attach a Google Sheets credential. 3) The sheet needs a 'Products' tab with the header row below. 4) Activate — it syncs every 5 minutes and can be run by hand any time.
meta.columns: id | name_he | name_en | price | old_price | price_he | old_price_he | stock_note | delivery_note | bullets | bullets_he | badge_he | image_url | forbidden_claims
meta.safety: maya-server REFUSES an empty or malformed payload. An emptied catalog would leave Maya with no facts at all, and under TRUTH LAW that means she answers 'I'll check' to every question for the rest of the stream. A row missing an id or a name fails the whole sync loudly instead of half-writing it.
meta.note: bullets and forbidden_claims are one cell each, separated by | or newlines.
